_readme: PRODUCTION content. Every null or empty value is something the client has not supplied yet. `npm run check:content` lists what is missing; `npm run build` refuses to build until the required fields are filled. Do not put invented facts here. The About text was written from the restaurant's own Instagram description. The hero text (eyebrow, headline, text) was taken from the home page design supplied on 2026-10-06. Both are awaiting the owner's approval. `about.values[].icon` names a drawing in src/partials/icon.html (leaf, utensils, cup, heart, users). Address, phone, hours, breakfast times, Maps link and domain were supplied by the client on 2026-10-05. PRIVACY POLICY (`legal.privacy`): drafted by the engineer on 2026-10-06 at the client's request, as a plain account of what this system actually does with a visitor's and an applicant's information. It has not been reviewed by a lawyer and awaits the owner's approval. It states that applications are kept for 90 days: that number is the client's choice (2026-10-06) and MUST equal the JOB_APPLICATION_RETENTION_DAYS secret of the Edge Functions. Change one, change the other. With the policy published, `careers.applications.enabled` is true and the application form is on the Careers page. NO EMAIL ADDRESS goes in this file: everything here is published. `locations[].email` stays null. The inbox that job applications are reported to is kept on the server, in the restaurant's row in the database (supabase/provision-restaurant.sql). PLACEHOLDER PHOTOS: the restaurant's own photos have not arrived, and on 2026-10-06 the instruction was to show placeholders on the live site until they do. Every file named placeholder-* in content/media/ is a stock photo from the design template, not a photo of this restaurant or its food, and its licence for publication was never checked (content/media/README.md). Replace each one with a real photo as it arrives. `defaultDishPhotos` are shown on the home page for a menu category or a featured dish that has no photo of its own; empty the list to switch that off. See docs/CONFIGURATION.md for ordering.url, careers.applications and legal.

about.headline: Mediterranean flavors, Western comfort
paragraphs: Luzena Restaurant & Cafe is where Mediterranean flavors meet Western comfort food. We bring the two together on one menu, so the whole table finds something to enjoy.
We cook fresh, and we cook to order. Each dish is prepared when you ask for it, not before.
We are a restaurant and a cafe under one roof. Join us for a full meal with family and friends, or simply drop in for a coffee.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: This website belongs to Luzena Restaurant & Cafe, 315 El Cajon Blvd, El Cajon, CA 92020. You can reach us on +1 619-499-5779 or in person at the restaurant.
This page explains what information the website collects and what we do with it.

sections.heading: Visiting the website
paragraphs: You can read the whole website without telling us who you are. There are no visitor accounts, no advertising and no analytics or tracking tools on it, and the website itself sets no cookies.

Like every website, our servers and the companies that host them receive your device's internet address and basic technical details when a page loads. We use these only to deliver the site and to keep it secure.
Our website does not follow you across other websites, so it does not behave differently when your browser sends a "Do Not Track" signal.

sections.heading: The map and links to other services
paragraphs: The map on the home page and the location page is provided by Google Maps. It loads when you scroll near it. When it does, Google receives your device's internet address and may set its own cookies, under Google's privacy policy.

Links to Instagram, to Google Maps and to online ordering take you to those services, which have their own privacy policies. Online orders and payments are handled by Clover on Clover's own pages. We do not see or store your card details.

sections.heading: Applying for a job
paragraphs: If you apply through the Join Our Team page, we collect what you enter in the form: your name, email address and phone number; the position you are applying for; whether you want full-time or part-time work, when you could work and when you could start; your experience; whether you are legally authorized to work in the United States; anything you write about yourself; and your resume or CV, if you choose to attach one.
We use this only to consider you for work at the restaurant and to contact you about your application. We do not sell it, and we do not use it for marketing.

Your application can be read only by the people at the restaurant who are responsible for hiring, after they sign in. When an application arrives, a short notice with your name, your contact details, the position and your answers to the multiple-choice questions is emailed to the restaurant's hiring inbox. Your resume and what you wrote in your own words are not included in that email.

Applications are stored with our hosting provider, Supabase, on servers in the United States. Resumes are kept in private storage and cannot be reached through a public link. The notice is sent through our email provider, Resend. To protect the form from misuse we also keep a scrambled record of the internet address an application was sent from, which cannot be turned back into the address.

sections.heading: How long we keep applications
paragraphs: We keep an application, and any resume sent with it, for 90 days after you apply. After that both are deleted, together with our notes on the application.

sections.heading: Your choices
paragraphs: You can ask us at any time what information we hold about you, or ask us to delete your application before the 90 days are up. Call us on +1 619-499-5779 or ask at the restaurant, and we will do it.

sections.heading: Changes to this page
paragraphs: If we change how we handle information, we will update this page and the date at the top.

careers.intro: We are building our opening team and looking for people who love food and great hospitality. Experience is a plus. Passion is a must.

positions.title: Restaurant Manager
positions.summary: Leads the whole restaurant and cafe day to day, and is responsible for the guest experience, the team and the numbers.
responsibilities: Run daily operations across the kitchen, the cafe and the dining room
Hire, train and schedule the team
Handle guest feedback and resolve problems on the spot
Manage stock, suppliers, costs and cash
Keep food safety and cleanliness standards met at all times
requirements: Experience managing a restaurant or cafe
Confident leading and motivating a team
Comfortable with ordering, rotas and basic reporting

positions.title: Assistant Manager / Shift Supervisor
positions.summary: Runs the shift, supports the manager and steps in wherever the team needs help.
responsibilities: Open and close the restaurant
Lead the team during service
Look after guests and deal with any issues
Handle the till and end-of-day cash-up
requirements: Experience in a supervisory role in hospitality
Calm and organised during busy service

positions.title: Head Chef
positions.summary: Leads the kitchen and owns the quality of every plate that leaves it.
responsibilities: Lead and train the kitchen team
Develop and maintain the menu and its recipes
Control ordering, stock and food cost
Keep the kitchen to food safety and hygiene standards
requirements: Strong knowledge of Mediterranean and Western cooking

positions.title: Sous Chef
positions.summary: Second in command in the kitchen, running service alongside the Head Chef.
responsibilities: Run the pass and keep service moving
Supervise and coach the cooks
Cover the kitchen when the Head Chef is away
Check quality, portions and presentation
requirements: Experience as a sous chef or senior line cook
Able to lead a team under pressure

positions.title: Line Cook
positions.summary: Cooks dishes to order on a station during service.
responsibilities: Prepare and cook dishes to the restaurant's recipes
Set up and stock your station before service
Keep your station clean and organised
Work with the team to send orders out on time
requirements: Experience cooking in a restaurant kitchen
Able to work quickly and accurately
Reliable and a good team player

positions.title: Prep Cook
positions.summary: Prepares ingredients so the kitchen is ready for service.
responsibilities: Wash, peel, chop and portion ingredients
Prepare sauces, dressings and basic recipes
Label, date and store food correctly
Keep the prep area clean
requirements: Kitchen experience is a plus, not a requirement

positions.title: Pastry Chef / Baker
positions.summary: Makes the desserts, pastries and baked goods for the restaurant and the cafe.
responsibilities: Bake and prepare pastries and desserts each day
Keep the cafe display fresh and well stocked
Follow recipes precisely and keep quality consistent
Manage pastry ingredients and stock

positions.title: Kitchen Assistant
positions.summary: Supports the cooks and keeps the kitchen running smoothly.
responsibilities: Help with basic food preparation
Receive and put away deliveries
Keep work surfaces, floors and storage areas clean
Assist wherever the kitchen needs an extra pair of hands

positions.title: Dishwasher / Kitchen Steward
positions.summary: Keeps dishes, equipment and the kitchen clean throughout service.
responsibilities: Wash dishes, pots, pans and utensils
Keep the dishwashing area tidy and safe
Empty bins and help with end-of-day cleaning
Put clean items back where they belong
requirements: Able to work on your feet in a busy kitchen

positions.title: Head Barista
positions.summary: Leads the coffee bar and sets the standard for every drink served.
responsibilities: Prepare espresso drinks and other beverages to a high standard
Train and guide the barista team
Look after the coffee machines and grinders
Order coffee, milk and cafe supplies
requirements: Able to dial in espresso and steam milk well

positions.title: Barista
positions.summary: Makes coffee and other drinks, and looks after cafe guests.
responsibilities: Prepare coffee, tea and other drinks
Take orders and serve guests at the counter
Keep the coffee bar clean and stocked
Handle payments accurately
requirements: Able to work quickly during busy periods

positions.title: Cafe Counter Attendant
positions.summary: Serves guests at the cafe counter and keeps the display looking its best.
responsibilities: Greet guests and take their orders
Serve food and drinks from the counter
Keep the display, tables and counter clean
Restock cups, napkins and other supplies

positions.title: Host / Hostess
positions.summary: The first person guests meet when they arrive.
responsibilities: Welcome guests and show them to their table
Manage the waiting list and seating plan
Answer the phone and help with enquiries
Thank guests as they leave

positions.title: Waiter / Waitress
positions.summary: Looks after guests at the table from the first hello to the bill.
responsibilities: Take food and drink orders accurately
Know the menu and answer guests' questions
Serve food and drinks and check that guests are happy
Present the bill and take payment
requirements: Able to stay calm and quick during busy service

positions.title: Food Runner
positions.summary: Brings dishes from the kitchen to the right table, quickly and correctly.
responsibilities: Deliver food to tables as soon as it is ready
Check each plate against the order
Support the servers and the kitchen during service
Help keep the dining room tidy

positions.title: Busser
positions.summary: Keeps tables clean and ready for the next guests.
responsibilities: Clear and reset tables
Refill water and bring bread or cutlery when needed
Keep the dining room and service stations stocked and clean
Support the servers

positions.title: Cashier
positions.summary: Takes orders and payments, and handles takeaway and online orders.
responsibilities: Take orders and payments at the till
Prepare and hand over takeaway and online orders
Answer questions about the menu
Balance the till at the end of the shift
requirements: Comfortable using a till or POS system

positions.title: Cleaner
positions.summary: Keeps the restaurant, the cafe and the restrooms spotless.
responsibilities: Clean dining areas, restrooms and entrances
Mop floors and empty bins
Restock soap, paper and other supplies
Report anything that needs repair
